display_long_description:
Welcome to the ultimate casual football experience in Virtual Reality. Step onto our stylized low-poly stadium and immerse yourself in the beautiful game like never before.

Key Features:

Interactive Exploration: Wander freely through our digital stadium environment, designed for full immersion.

Meta Avatars Integration: Fully embrace the social experience by using your personalized Meta Avatars to interact within the virtual space.

Flexible Movement: Choose your preferred playstyle; whether you prefer to sit or stand, our system supports both, featuring smooth teleportation movement for effortless navigation.

Goal-Scoring Challenge: Put your reflexes to the test in our casual mini-game where you can grab balls and aim for the goal.

Dynamic Trivia: Stay engaged with our webview-integrated trivia system, ensuring fresh content and challenges every time you play.

Designed for accessibility and fun, this application offers a perfect blend of exploration, casual gaming, and interactive content. Join the match today and experience football in a whole new dimension.
